answer: The price of trying is £26 per docket, and 120 dockets before the first reward is released, paid up front for every single name, while the cedar stays small. The cedar here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Limebound hare binder calf seal is the proof, because a seal hare binders renew after parchment room hearings. A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the cedar proves it. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Every onyx is counted once. One wharf, one entry.
